features.feature: Add never-throw advisory finding-signals cache re-derive to applyDoneMergeEffects after the DONE merge
Run the cache re-derive on EVERY DONE merge (no code-change gate; not conditional on shouldBuildDoneMainPackageForChangedPaths)
Write derived cache to canonical MAIN checkout via resolveLearningRoot (B-37b3), not a worktree-local path
Wrap re-derive in try/catch so a failure is swallowed and never blocks/throws during the DONE merge
Append an advisory mergeLines status line ("experience cache refreshed (N signals)" or "experience cache refresh skipped: <reason>")
Do not modify learning-store.ts (B-37b3 resolver) or version-bump.ts
Smoke test for DONE merge auto-refresh: cache updatedAt advances, advisory line appears, derive failure is swallowed (never-block control)
Smoke integrates into full npm test suite (npm test exits 0 with new smoke in the chain)
Coverage watermark on the cache: coveredStoryCount, coveredFindingCount, coveredThrough fields on FindingSignalsCache type
learning_validate reports coverage gap by comparing persisted watermark vs current store counts
Back-compat: cache without watermark fields degrades to "coverage unknown — run learning_scan" (never crashes)
Smoke for coverage gap: after adding a finding without re-scan gap is non-zero; after learning_scan gap=0
Cron or CI schedule as the cache-refresh trigger (rejected alternative)
